description: The 95% CL upper limits on the product of the cross section, branching fraction, and acceptance for dijet resonances decaying to quark-quark. Limits are compared to predicted cross sections for axigluons, colorons, scalar diquarks, new gauge bosons W' and Z' with SM-like couplings and dark matter mediators.
name: Cross-section limits for a quark-quark type dijet resonance
